notes: Baselines trained on the same 75501 train / 24196 val windows; LR/SVR/XGBoost are single-horizon (one model per horizon) on look-back glucose + sin/cos time of day; LSTM/N-BEATS/N-HiTS are multi-horizon, trained with MSE and early stopping on validation (patience 10).
SVR is fit on a seeded uniform subsample of at most 10000 training windows (kernel SVR scales quadratically).
